mapper.select: select c.eid, c.badge, c.depid, w.location CHARGE_NAME, c.empname username, c.nature, c.empstatus, t.pk_id, t.project_code, t.project_name, t.competent_dept, t.sys_no, t.sys_name, t.start_date, t.end_date, t.create_by, t.create_date, t.update_by, t.update_date, t.project_state, t.head_user, t.dev_user, t.deleted, t.participating_dept, t.bus_innova, (select sum(CONTRACT_AMOUNT) from rd_project_contract r where t.PK_ID=r.RD_PROJECT_ID) CONTRACT_AMOUNT, (select LISTAGG(CONTRACT_NAME,',') within group(order by CONTRACT_NAME) from rd_project_contract r where t.PK_ID=r.RD_PROJECT_ID) CONTRACT_NAME, t.tech_innova, (select count(E.EID) from ppm.RD_PROJECT_EMPLOYEE g where g.PROJECT_CODE = E.PROJECT_CODE and g.isdisabled = '0' ) as no from ppm.COMM_RD_EMPLOYEE C left join ppm.RD_PROJECT_EMPLOYEE E on c.eid = e.eid left join ppm.rd_project t on e.project_code = t.project_code left join ppm.comm_rd_department w on (c.depid = w.depid) where t.DELETED = '0' and t.project_state in ('1', '2','9') and e.isdisabled = '0' AND c.eid =#{eid}

SELECT PK_ID, RD_PROJECT_ID, FILE_NAME, FILE_PATH, CREATE_BY, CREATE_DATE, DELETED, TYPE, SOURCE_FILE_NAME, BELONG_USER FROM WORK_RESEARCH_FILE
RD_PROJECT_ID =#{pkId} AND BELONG_USER =#{badge} AND
ORDER BY CREATE_DATE DESC

SELECT C.EMPNAME, T.LOCATION CHARGE_NAME, C.EID, C.BADGE, C.EMPSTATUS, C.LEAVE_TIME, C.DEPID, C.NATURE, (SELECT CASE when (select count(*) from rd_project t left join ppm.RD_PROJECT_EMPLOYEE e on (e.project_code = t.project_code) where e.eid = c.eid and e.isdisabled = '0' and t.PROJECT_STATE = '9') = 0 then 0 WHEN (select count(*) from rd_project t left join ppm.RD_PROJECT_EMPLOYEE e on (e.project_code = t.project_code) where e.eid = c.eid and e.isdisabled = '0' and t.PROJECT_STATE = '9') > (select count(distinct RD_PROJECT_ID) from rd_project R left join ppm.RD_PROJECT_EMPLOYEE e on (e.project_code = R.project_code) left join WORK_RESEARCH_FILE w on (R.pk_id = w.rd_project_id) where e.eid = c.eid and w.rd_project_id = r.pk_id and w.belong_user = c.badge and e.isdisabled = '0' and R.PROJECT_STATE = '9') then 1 WHEN (select count(*) from rd_project t left join ppm.RD_PROJECT_EMPLOYEE e on (e.project_code = t.project_code) where e.eid = c.eid and e.isdisabled = '0' and t.PROJECT_STATE = '9') = (select count(distinct RD_PROJECT_ID) from rd_project R left join ppm.RD_PROJECT_EMPLOYEE e on (e.project_code = R.project_code) left join WORK_RESEARCH_FILE w on (R.pk_id = w.rd_project_id) where e.eid = c.eid and w.rd_project_id = r.pk_id and e.isdisabled = '0' and w.belong_user = c.badge and R.PROJECT_STATE = '9') then 2 end FROM dual ) as fin_doc_state, (SELECT CASE when (select count(*) from rd_project t left join ppm.RD_PROJECT_EMPLOYEE e on (e.project_code = t.project_code) where e.eid = c.eid and e.isdisabled = '0' and t.PROJECT_STATE in ('1', '2')) = 0 then 0
WHEN (select count(*) from rd_project t left join ppm.RD_PROJECT_EMPLOYEE e on (e.project_code = t.project_code) where e.eid = c.eid and e.isdisabled = '0' and t.PROJECT_STATE in ('1', '2')) > (select count(distinct RD_PROJECT_ID) from rd_project R left join ppm.RD_PROJECT_EMPLOYEE e on (e.project_code = R.project_code) left join WORK_RESEARCH_FILE w on (R.pk_id = w.rd_project_id) where e.eid = c.eid and w.rd_project_id = r.pk_id and w.belong_user = c.badge and e.isdisabled = '0' and R.PROJECT_STATE in ('1', '2')) then 1 WHEN (select count(*) from rd_project t left join ppm.RD_PROJECT_EMPLOYEE e on (e.project_code = t.project_code) where e.eid = c.eid and e.isdisabled = '0' and t.PROJECT_STATE in ('1', '2')) = (select count(distinct RD_PROJECT_ID) from rd_project R left join ppm.RD_PROJECT_EMPLOYEE e on (e.project_code = R.project_code) left join WORK_RESEARCH_FILE w on (R.pk_id = w.rd_project_id) where e.eid = c.eid and w.rd_project_id = r.pk_id and w.belong_user = c.badge and e.isdisabled = '0' and R.PROJECT_STATE in ('1', '2')) then 2 end FROM dual ) as unfin_doc_state from COMM_RD_EMPLOYEE C left join PPM.COMM_RD_DEPARTMENT T ON (C.DEPID = T.DEPID)
C.DEPID = #{depid} AND C.BADGE = #{badge} AND

SELECT resu.LOCATION AS DEPT_NAME, resu.EMPNAME AS USER_NAME, resu.BADGE , resu.PROJECT_NAME, resu.PROJECT_STATE, CASE WHEN FILE_NAME IS NULL THEN '未上传' WHEN FILE_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN '已上传' END AS UPLOAD_STATE , wrfi.FILE_NAME, wrfi."TYPE", wrfi.CREATE_DATE FROM ( SELECT crd.LOCATION , cre.EMPNAME , cre.BADGE , rp.PROJECT_NAME, rp.PK_ID, rp.PROJECT_STATE FROM COMM_RD_EMPLOYEE cre LEFT JOIN RD_PROJECT_EMPLOYEE rpe ON rpe.EID = cre.EID LEFT JOIN RD_PROJECT rp ON rp.PROJECT_CODE = rpe.PROJECT_CODE LEFT JOIN COMM_RD_DEPARTMENT crd ON cre.DEPID = crd.DEPID
crd.DEPID IN
TO_NUMBER(#{item})
AND
rp.PROJECT_CODE IN
#{item}
AND
rp.START_DATE between #{entryStartDate} and #{entryEndDate} AND
cre.BADGE = #{badge} AND
) resu LEFT JOIN WORK_RESEARCH_FILE wrfi ON wrfi.RD_PROJECT_ID = resu.PK_ID AND wrfi.BELONG_USER = resu.BADGE ORDER BY resu.LOCATION , resu.EMPNAME
SELECT rp.PROJECT_CODE AS projectCode, rp.PROJECT_NAME AS projectName FROM PPM.RD_PROJECT rp ORDER BY PROJECT_CODE DESC
